18.note: V1 wins for being direct, natural and firm without changing the demand. V4 adds an unprovided concern about whether the messages arrived and softens the opening stance. V6 omits that this is the second payment and has less Chilean phrasing. V3 and V5 are identical.

V2 changes desirable immediate availability to starting soon. V3 also changes availability, requires prior SII experience rather than knowledge and proficiency, and broadens administrative support to whatever arises. Subject-line punctuation changes are minor.

V6 invents preferences and career motivations while dropping named metrics, training details and the digital/in-store sales aim. All still require template completion.

V3 invents that the responsibility forced the applicant to learn and adds 'always.' V6 invents frequent monitoring, careful spending habits and a new reason for choosing retail.

V3 strengthens water resistance into handling rain and remaining waterproof. V5 newly claims that the seller makes the bag. V6 adds effortless southern-rain protection, stronger impact protection, direct-sun advice and a 'like new' result after waxing.

V6 loses the explicit distinction that the money being tracked belongs to the business. V1 and V2 preserve the substance.
